entities.name: PMID:27506585
observations: Randomized study analyzed 65 adults with radiographic grade 1–2 knee OA: acetaminophen 500 mg every 8 h for 6 weeks (n=32) versus three LP-PRP injections (n=33); follow-up was 24 weeks.

Abstract reports greater VAS pain reduction, sustained WOMAC/function improvement, and SF-12 quality-of-life improvement with LP-PRP; numerical between-group effect sizes and detailed adverse-event data are not supplied in the abstract.

entities.name: PMID:25312315
observations: Preliminary randomized comparison enrolled 42 patients with grade I knee OA; PRP (two 5-mL applications) versus oral paracetamol 1 g every 8 h for 30 days; both groups received supervised rehabilitation during six months.
PRP group's KOOS reportedly improved from 30.1 to 48.2; abstract notes no significant between-group difference in IL-1β or TNF-α, and does not report a full comparative KOOS estimate.
